snippet.title: Battle Magi | Gameplay PC | Steam | GandaCu
snippet.description:
Battle Magi
Battle Magi is a multiplayer PvP first-person arena shooter where magic replaces guns and your voice becomes the ultimate weapon.

Welcome to the Battle
Summoned from across time and space, the greatest mages are forced into brutal arenas to fight for respect, dominance, and survival.

Master a voice-driven magic system, combine powerful spells with devastating runes, and outplay your opponents in chaotic, high-skill PvP combat.

Whether you prefer total mayhem or coordinated teamwork, every match is a test of reflexes, positioning, and spell mastery.

Key Features
Multiplayer PvP for up to 8 players
Jump into intense arena battles designed for constant action.

Multiple competitive game modes
Fight in Free for All (FFA), Team Deathmatch (TDM), and Capture the Flag (CTF).

Voice-based spell casting
Cast spells using your voice for fast, immersive, and skill-based combat.

Sixteen powerful and unique spells
Control the battlefield with fire, frost, lightning, traps, shields, and mobility abilities.

Six ultimate runes
Gain temporary power boosts:
Cataclysm, Haste, Overload, Regeneration, Resistance, and Stasis.

Four unique arena maps
Each arena is designed to encourage movement, positioning, and creative spell usage.

Thank You For Watching! You The Best!!
